hypotheses.D1_powerlaw_bulk_holds_at_all_layers: Every layer has bulk log-log R-squared at least 0.90.
hypotheses.D2_outlier_excess_predicts_natural_use: Leading log excess and natural rank-one efficiency have Spearman correlation at least 0.60.
hypotheses.D3_outlier_excess_predicts_operator_comp: Leading log excess and median cleaned-address operator K90 have Spearman correlation at most -0.50.
hypotheses.D4_strongest_outliers_are_small_native_c: All three layers with highest leading log excess have median native-channel Shapley K90 at most 64.
hypotheses.D5_compact_operator_broad_channel_mismat: At least six layers have median operator K90 at most 64 and median channel K90 at least four times median operator K90.
hypotheses.D6_clean_address_recurrence_beats_sign_n: At every layer, top-eight channel recurrence across four clean addresses exceeds recurrence across four sign-null addresses.
hypotheses.D7_clean_addresses_are_more_distributed_: At least six layers have clean median channel K90 at least four times sign-null median channel K90.
hypotheses.D8_strong_outliers_are_output_pure: All three layers with highest leading log excess have median leading-output role fraction at least 0.50.
